scope_change: Add a provenance and data-quality audit of the V1.0 public Korean industrial-load source. The simulation DGPs, methods, candidate set, tariff cells, seeds, replications, and primary endpoints in exp1_protocol.json are unchanged.

korea_public_load_source.dataset: Datasets on South Korean manufacturing factories' electricity consumption and demand response participation

limitations: No customer-specific tariff contracts, billing records, actual tariff choices, or realized tariff savings are included.
The seven-month observation period does not cover a full annual seasonal cycle.
The dataset is one public data resource and the factory records are not independent external cohorts.

processing_audit.primary_window: fixed non-overlapping 15-minute mean; require all 15 minute values; no imputation
processing_audit.natural_tail_variant: remove documented demand-response intervals plus the frozen 60-minute rebound buffer
processing_audit.eligibility: factory-month with at least 95% complete windows; retain 90% sensitivity in the archived source pipeline
processing_audit.verification: raw-file SHA-256 against archived V1.0 files and input manifest; monthly maxima reconciled against archived eligibility table

korea_public_load_source.relationship_to_v2_submission: The current V2.0 submission already contains an 8-factory, 4-origin rolling external analysis with counterfactual tariff charges. EXP1 audits the raw and derived inputs; this audit is not a new bill-validation study and does not replace the simulated oracle pilot.

extension_rule_operationalization.reference_scale: median oracle expected monthly bill across distinct tariff cells, computed separately by DGP
extension_rule_operationalization.comparison_set: all non-self method-versus-baseline contrasts against TAIL_LEGACY_LOG, CV_COST_ZPEN, and EMP at both 24 and 60 months
extension_rule_operationalization.required_total_replications: max(100, ceil((paired contrast SD / target MCSE)^2)) across the comparison set within each DGP
extension_rule_operationalization.decision: if required total R is between 101 and 200, extend to that fixed R; if greater than 200, stop and redesign precision; otherwise retain R=100
extension_rule_operationalization.prohibited_selection: Do not use contrast direction, p-values, or significance to choose the extension.
